author: Wahiz
body:
Ok, so if you clicked on this you must be Iron or just curious.

I have an argument regarding my ban that I didn't realized when I first confronted you about it, The evidence that was provided was me saying something to a member of the team sagrevyum that was saying shit to me in the first place, so if you don't know me by now I'm gonna respond they way he said the things to me. Also, me spamming "fatty" was also being done by other users but you know what? They were not punished either. Also, those messages were displayed in chat on a scrim server. And from what I've seen 30+ players get away with violating chat in a similar manner as me, Here's an example. Gummi3 was reported w/ evidence that he was using racial slurs in chat. He then confronted Micheal [Newcleus] about his recent infraction, and Newcleus had lifted that infraction because it was on a scrim server.

Many people have said that these following rules do not apply to scrim servers.
-Combat Logging
-Team Greifing
-Team Trolling
-Excessive Caps
-Swearing (If Not Excessive or Directed, But Gummi3 was directing the racial slurs at someone and he's appealed)

And the last piece of evidence I was provided with was two accounts of me sending something like this in chat
(abhqdbwnsnfuwengfiwenfie) and Spookeh had warned me and then I stopped. But I got a verbal warn for that, so how could that be used as evidence if I was already informed that I shouldn't have done that.

If none of this will help my current status I will continue to wait the time (4 months, I was told) and then appeal and improve my behavior from now until then. If you would like to talk to me (Senior +) feel free to contact me on skype which is provided on my profile.

Regards, Dawson.

EDIT: And regarding the Prior Infraction thing, Rilo was the one who was involved in that.

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
I'll post it here since the post is currently unviewable to regulars.

When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network, please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false?
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?
  • Have I been caught ban evading?
  • Have I appealed a ban before?
When it comes to appealing an infraction. The only thing that helps it is the amount of time you serve that infraction.

Do not expect to be appealed a day after you ban if you know that it wasn't a false ban. You must face the consequences.

Regarding second appeals:
Each player only gets one chance when it comes to hacking. If you have already appealed once for hacking and you end up getting banned the second time, do not expect the second appeal to go well. They will most likely be denied automatically.

Regarding ban evasion:
Well, of course if you evade a ban, the second account will be banned. If this happens, chances of appealing it will be 0.
When evading a temp ban via an alt account, we will be banning both accounts from the server, so don't do it.

Appeal System
When someone appeals, their appeal will be sent in a thread form on the forums. If the moderator who banned this person is still staff, this moderator will proceed to negotiating with the player that wishes to be appealed. Once a  final verdict has been reached, and the user is happy with the decision made, a senior moderator will review the appeal. If the senior moderator is happy with the response given, they will proceed to lock the thread, and that will complete the appeal.

If the punisher is no longer staff, a senior staff member will step in and negotiate with the user instead of a moderator, and will reach a final verdict.
